headlines.headline: SENSEX off the day’s high, NIFTY trades flat in noon deals; Bajaj Finance, Cupid, Ola Electric among buzzing stocks

headlines.headline: SBI, IOB, PNB shares fly high; NIFTY PSU Bank index surges 15% in a month

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX trade higher after negative open on Nov 12; M&M, Bharti Airtel, IT stocks among top losers

headlines.headline: ITC shares rise 2% amid reports of cigarette price hikes; here is what we know so far
headlines.summary: According to news reports, ITC has raised the price of its Gold Flake RSFT cigarette pack by around 8% to ₹135 from ₹125 earlier, marking another price hike for the brand this year.

headlines.summary: Tata Power on Wednesday posted a record net profit of ₹1,652 crore for the September quarter (Q2 FY27), on the back of strong performance across all business segments.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank reclaims 61,000: HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Federal Bank, other banking stocks rally up to 6%; here's why
headlines.summary: Banking stocks surging up to 6% powered the NIFTY Bank index to reclaim its position above 61,000 levels, near its lifetime high, as investors focus on the broader market rally amid FII buying support.

headlines.summary: Indian equity indices rallied over 1% after opening higher on Wednesday, November 11, with key focus on lower crude oil prices, massive FII buying support and positive geopolitical sentiment in the market.

headlines.headline: HUL raises prices, Dabur signals increase: Is India's FMCG sector entering a new pricing cycle?
headlines.summary: HUL has raised the maximum retail prices (MRPs) of several products across its home care portfolio, including popular detergent brands Surf Excel, Rin and Wheel, by up to 11%, amid continued cost pressures and efforts to protect margins.

headlines.headline: Can Reliance Industries disrupt India’s biscuit market like cola? Britannia CEO weighs in; stocks in focus
headlines.summary: Reliance Consumer Products Ltd (RCPL), the FMCG arm of RIL, has expanded its Independence biscuit portfolio with 28 new stock-keeping units (SKUs) across nine variants.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers on Nov 9: SBI, Trent up 2%, Nestle gains 1.9%; Tata Steel, HCL Tech drop over 2% among top movers
headlines.summary: As the equity indices end higher after a turbulent session on November 9, stocks like SBI, Trent, and Nestle India emerged as top gainers, while others like Tata Steel, and IT stocks among others were subject to selling pressure.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 9: SENSEX rises 107 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 25,044 as PSU Bank, pharma stocks rally; SBI leads gains
headlines.summary: The market breadth was in favour of declines as 1,959 out of 3,698 traded stocks ended session in red.
